title: The smooth real density line bundle
statement: Let $N$ be a smooth real $m$-manifold without boundary [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold]. Define the real density line $\mathrm{Dens}_N=|\Lambda^mT^*N|$ by gluing one trivial real line over each smooth chart $x:U\to\mathbf R^m$, with local generator $|dx^1\cdots dx^m|$. For $p$ in an overlap with a chart $y$, put $g_{xy}(p)=|\det D(y\circ x^{-1})(x(p))|$. The smooth positive cocycle and reciprocal identities used below are [lem-sfb-chart-absolute-jacobian-cocycle]. On that overlap, identify $|dy^1\cdots dy^m|=|\det D(y\circ x^{-1})(x)|\,|dx^1\cdots dx^m|$. Explicitly, a coefficient $a$ in the $x$ generator and a coefficient $b$ in the $y$ generator represent the same fibre vector precisely when $a=b\,|\det D(y\circ x^{-1})|$. The total space is the quotient of the disjoint union of chart trivial lines by these identifications, with the quotient topology and local coefficient maps $[x,p,a]\mapsto(p,a/g_{xy}(p))$ over the $y$ chart. Its smooth bundle structure is the smooth cocycle construction [def-sfb-smooth-vector-bundle-core], using coefficient transitions $T_{xy}(p)(a)=a/g_{xy}(p)$; this makes $\mathrm{Dens}_N$ a smooth rank-one real vector bundle [def-sfb-smooth-real-vector-bundle] over $N$. A smooth density is a smooth section of this line [def-sfb-smooth-bundle-sections]. No orientation is required.

Item: the transition direction is right. dy^1∧…∧dy^m = det D(y∘x^{-1}) dx^1∧…∧dx^m gives |dy| = g_xy|dx| and so a = b·g_xy. Then T_xy(a) = a/g_xy satisfies coordChange_self (g_xx = 1) and coordChange_comp (T_yz T_xy = T_xz from g_xz = g_yz g_xy), and it is smooth because 1/g_xy is smooth. The item uses no orientation, adds no hypothesis and does not weaken the object. It identifies the quotient topology with the core topology through the cocycle-defined map and the localTriv charts.
